requirements.text: Uses the first existing template among .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, .github/pull_request_template.md, PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, and pull_request_template.md.
Keeps template headings and order and marks inapplicable sections N/A.
Grounds every PR claim in the actual diff and names gaps instead of inventing completion.
Under required reviews, does not declare readiness from green checks or author-only approval.
Bases readiness on fresh evidence for both review state (reviewDecision) and required checks (statusCheckRollup or gh pr checks), plus mergeStateStatus; checks alone are insufficient.
Merges with gh pr merge --squash unless the repository standardizes another allowed method.
Uses --admin only when repository policy explicitly permits the bypass.
After merge, confirms state with repository-scoped gh pr view --json state,mergedAt and treats organization-wide search results as possibly stale.
Routes review-comment replies to openai-gh-address-comments, failing-check repair to openai-gh-fix-ci, and diff review to internal-review-code.

cases.initial_state: The gh pr view fixture is fresh evidence for PR 88.
cases.expected_output: A not-ready verdict naming the missing non-author approval and citing reviewDecision and mergeStateStatus.

assertions.text: Output says not ready and names the missing non-author approval.
Cites reviewDecision REVIEW_REQUIRED and mergeStateStatus BLOCKED.

cases.prompt: I approved my own PR 94 and checks are green; can I merge?
cases.initial_state: The gh pr view fixture is fresh evidence for PR 94.
cases.expected_output: A not-ready answer explaining that the author's own approval does not count.

assertions.text: Output says not ready despite green checks.

cases.prompt: Open a PR for this branch using our template.
cases.initial_state: The repository tree fixture lists two templates.
cases.expected_output: A PR body built from .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md with its four headings in order.

assertions.text: Output uses .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and keeps its headings in order.
Marks sections without content N/A instead of deleting them.

cases.prompt: Update the PR description to match the final diff.
cases.initial_state: The diff changes two files and adds no tests.
cases.expected_output: A PR body whose claims all map to diff hunks, with the missing tests named as a gap.

assertions.text: Every claimed change maps to a diff hunk.

pass: Each claimed change maps to a diff hunk and the missing tests are stated.
fail: Claims a test or change absent from the diff.

cases.initial_state: Repository policy does not mention admin bypass; PR 12 is blocked on review.
cases.expected_output: A refusal to use --admin without a policy basis and a squash merge once requirements are met.

assertions.text: Uses squash and no --admin without a policy citation.

pass: Declines --admin, cites the missing policy, and names the unmet requirement.

cases.prompt: Confirm PR 91 is actually merged; search still shows it open.
cases.initial_state: The fixture holds both search and repository view output.
cases.expected_output: A merged verdict based on the repository-scoped view, noting the stale search result.

assertions.text: Output reports merged from gh pr view --json state,mergedAt despite an open search hit.

cases.prompt: Address the review comments on my open PR.
cases.initial_state: The PR has three unresolved review threads.

assertions.text: Output routes to openai-gh-address-comments and drafts no replies.

cases.prompt: The lint check fails on my PR; fix the workflow.

assertions.text: Output routes to openai-gh-fix-ci and makes no workflow edit.

cases.prompt: Review the code in PR 55 for bugs.

assertions.text: Output routes to internal-review-code and emits no findings.
